401909854.d: Donovan Mitchell scored 22 points, Jarrett Allen added 21 points, and the Cleveland Cavaliers won their home opener, 125-121 over the Brooklyn Nets on Saturday night.

news.h: Miami Heat vs. Charlotte Hornets: Game Highlights
news.d: Miami Heat vs. Charlotte Hornets: Game Highlights

news.h: Mavericks' Cooper Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
news.d: Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced. He will not play against the Spurs.

news.h: 76ers' LeBron James to sit vs. Bucks in first game of back-to-back
news.d: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.

news.h: Magic's Paolo Banchero has ankle sprain; out multiple weeks, sources say
news.d: Magic star Paolo Banchero has sustained a low-grade high ankle sprain, the team announced, with sources telling ESPN that the forward will miss multiple weeks.

news.h: Saturday's fantasy basketball adds and bets to make in the NBA
news.d: Jim McCormick breaks down Saturday's slate, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and bets to make.

news.h: Ex-NBA player Malik Beasley negotiating plea deal in gambling case
news.d: Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed.

news.h: Phoenix soar high and down the 36ers
news.d: The South East Melbourne Phoenix were lights out from beyond the arc, making 18 three-pointers in their win over the Adelaide 36ers.

news.h: Amen Thompson stuffs Wembanyama's last-second shot as Rockets hold off Spurs
news.d: Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama at the rim to prevent a potential tying bucket as the Rockets beat the Spurs 114-110.

news.d: The Warriors appeared to be in control before "pretty much everything went wrong" in the final four minutes, when the Grizzlies rallied from 12 down to win 111-108.
